title: Typed Document IR
summary: Markdown compiles into immutable typed in-memory nodes with provenance before any HTML is rendered.
invariants: IR is created in memory and is derived and disposable.
No page JSON or JSONL is mandatory; serialization is limited to disposable cache, search index, --dump-ir or test evidence.
Every node has source file, line and column.
HTML never re-enters the parser as trusted content.
